sv.title: Fyra ambulanser larmades till trafikolycka
sv.summary: Under natten mot lördag inträffade en singelolycka i närheten av Borgeby. Fyra ambulanser larmades till platsen.

en.title: Four ambulances dispatched to traffic accident
en.summary: During the night towards Saturday, a single-vehicle accident occurred near Borgeby. Four ambulances were dispatched to the scene.
